pages.text: A blank turned with k-fold rotation and k mirror planes has the dihedral symmetry group D_k, of order 2k: that many ways to move it and have it look the same. The group must match the recipe's. A fine indexing head on a fast spindle shakes.
$(thing)Set$(): Indexing order k, Spindle speed.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Chatter: the wobble varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The blank shakes apart.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A faster spindle is faster.
